scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev -w apps/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/frontend"
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:push: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma db push
scripts.prisma:deploy: npm exec -w apps/backend prisma migrate deploy
scripts.prisma:safe: npm run prisma:format && npm run prisma:validate && npm run prisma:migrate --
